title: Benim günüm
text: My name is Deniz. I am nineteen years old and I live in Izmir. I live with my mother, my father and my sister. Every morning I get up at seven o'clock. I drink tea and eat bread with cheese. Then I go to school by bus. My favorite lesson is English. I do not like math because it is difficult for me. After school I play football with my friends in the park. In the evening I help my mother in the kitchen. I go to bed at eleven o'clock.
textTr: Benim adım Deniz. On dokuz yaşındayım ve İzmir'de yaşıyorum. Annem, babam ve kız kardeşimle birlikte yaşıyorum. Her sabah saat yedide kalkarım. Çay içerim ve peynirli ekmek yerim. Sonra okula otobüsle giderim. En sevdiğim ders İngilizce. Matematiği sevmem çünkü benim için zor. Okuldan sonra parkta arkadaşlarımla futbol oynarım. Akşamları mutfakta anneme yardım ederim. Saat on birde yatarım.

questions.q: How old is Deniz?
questions.note: İlk cümlede geçiyor: "I am nineteen years old."

questions.q: How does Deniz go to school?
questions.note: "Then I go to school by bus."

questions.q: Which lesson does Deniz not like?
questions.note: "I do not like math because it is difficult."

questions.q: What does Deniz do after school?
questions.note: "After school I play football with my friends."

questions.q: Who does Deniz help in the evening?
questions.note: "In the evening I help my mother in the kitchen."

title: Küçük bir kafe
text: There is a small cafe near my house in Ankara. It opens at eight in the morning and closes at ten at night. The cafe is not big, but it is very clean and warm. My friend Ayse works there. She makes coffee and sells cakes. The coffee is not expensive and the cakes are delicious. On Saturday I go there with my brother. We sit near the window and read the newspaper. Sometimes we stay for two hours. The cafe is quiet in the morning but it is busy after five o'clock.
textTr: Ankara'da evimin yakınında küçük bir kafe var. Sabah sekizde açılıyor, gece onda kapanıyor. Kafe büyük değil ama çok temiz ve sıcak. Arkadaşım Ayşe orada çalışıyor. Kahve yapıyor ve kek satıyor. Kahve pahalı değil, kekler de çok lezzetli. Cumartesi günü kardeşimle oraya giderim. Pencerenin yanına oturur, gazete okuruz. Bazen iki saat kalırız. Kafe sabahları sakin ama saat beşten sonra kalabalık oluyor.

questions.q: When does the cafe close?
questions.note: "It opens at eight in the morning and closes at ten at night."

questions.q: What does Ayse sell?
questions.note: "She makes coffee and sells cakes."

questions.q: Where do they sit?
questions.note: "We sit near the window."

questions.q: When is the cafe busy?
questions.note: "It is busy after five o'clock."

title: Yeni bir şehir
text: Mert is twenty-three years old. Last month he moved from Bursa to Istanbul because he has a new job. He works in a bank from nine to five. His office is in a tall building near the sea. Mert lives in a small flat with two other men. The flat is not expensive but it is not near his office, so he takes the train every day. Istanbul is very big and sometimes he feels alone. But he likes his job and he has new friends now. Next summer his family will visit him.
textTr: Mert yirmi üç yaşında. Geçen ay yeni bir işi olduğu için Bursa'dan İstanbul'a taşındı. Bir bankada dokuzdan beşe kadar çalışıyor. Ofisi denize yakın yüksek bir binada. Mert iki başka adamla küçük bir dairede yaşıyor. Daire pahalı değil ama ofisine yakın değil, o yüzden her gün trene biniyor. İstanbul çok büyük ve bazen kendini yalnız hissediyor. Ama işini seviyor ve artık yeni arkadaşları var. Gelecek yaz ailesi onu ziyaret edecek.

questions.q: Why did Mert move to Istanbul?
questions.note: "He moved ... because he has a new job."

questions.q: Where is his office?
options: In a tall building near the sea
questions.note: "His office is in a tall building near the sea."

questions.q: How does Mert travel to work?
questions.note: "He takes the train every day."

questions.q: How does Mert sometimes feel?
questions.note: "Sometimes he feels alone."

title: Market listesi
text: It is Sunday morning and Elif is in the supermarket. She has a list in her hand. She needs milk, eggs, rice and some apples. She also wants to buy fish for dinner, but the fish is very expensive today, so she buys chicken. At the door she sees her neighbor. They talk about the weather for ten minutes. Elif pays and puts everything in two bags. The bags are heavy and her house is not near, so she takes a taxi home.
textTr: Pazar sabahı ve Elif süpermarkette. Elinde bir liste var. Süt, yumurta, pirinç ve biraz elma lazım. Ayrıca akşam yemeği için balık almak istiyor ama balık bugün çok pahalı, o yüzden tavuk alıyor. Kapıda komşusunu görüyor. On dakika hava hakkında konuşuyorlar. Elif ödeme yapıyor ve her şeyi iki poşete koyuyor. Poşetler ağır ve evi yakın değil, bu yüzden eve taksiyle gidiyor.

questions.q: What day is it?
questions.note: "It is Sunday morning."

questions.q: Why does Elif buy chicken?
questions.note: "The fish is very expensive today, so she buys chicken."

questions.q: Who does she see at the door?
questions.note: "At the door she sees her neighbor."

questions.q: How does Elif go home?
questions.note: Poşetler ağır olduğu için taksiye biniyor.

title: Hafta sonu planı
text: Can and Selin are brother and sister. Next weekend they want to go to the mountains with their parents. Their father has a small car and the drive is three hours. They will stay in a hotel for two nights. Selin wants to walk in the forest and take photos. Can does not like walking, but he likes swimming, and there is a river near the hotel. Their mother says the weather will be cold at night, so they must take warm clothes. Can is happy because there is no school on Monday.
textTr: Can ve Selin kardeşler. Gelecek hafta sonu anne babalarıyla dağlara gitmek istiyorlar. Babalarının küçük bir arabası var ve yolculuk üç saat sürüyor. Bir otelde iki gece kalacaklar. Selin ormanda yürümek ve fotoğraf çekmek istiyor. Can yürümeyi sevmiyor ama yüzmeyi seviyor ve otelin yakınında bir nehir var. Anneleri gece havanın soğuk olacağını söylüyor, bu yüzden kalın kıyafet almaları gerekiyor. Can mutlu çünkü pazartesi okul yok.

questions.q: How long is the drive?
questions.note: "The drive is three hours."

questions.q: What does Selin want to do?
questions.note: "Selin wants to walk in the forest and take photos."

questions.q: Why must they take warm clothes?
options: It will be cold at night
questions.note: Anneleri gece havanın soğuk olacağını söylüyor.

questions.q: Why is Can happy?
options: There is no school on Monday
questions.note: "Can is happy because there is no school on Monday."

title: Doğum günü
text: Today is Zeynep's birthday. She is eight years old. Her mother makes a big cake with chocolate. Her father buys a red bicycle for her. In the afternoon her friends come to the house. They sing a song and eat cake. Zeynep opens her presents. She gets two books, a doll and a white hat. Her friend Kaya gives her a small cat. Zeynep is very happy. In the evening she is tired but she does not want to go to bed.
textTr: Bugün Zeynep'in doğum günü. Sekiz yaşında. Annesi çikolatalı büyük bir pasta yapıyor. Babası ona kırmızı bir bisiklet alıyor. Öğleden sonra arkadaşları eve geliyor. Şarkı söyleyip pasta yiyorlar. Zeynep hediyelerini açıyor. İki kitap, bir bebek ve beyaz bir şapka alıyor. Arkadaşı Kaya ona küçük bir kedi veriyor. Zeynep çok mutlu. Akşam yorgun ama yatmak istemiyor.

questions.q: How old is Zeynep today?
questions.note: "She is eight years old."

questions.q: What does her father buy?
questions.note: "Her father buys a red bicycle for her."

questions.q: What does Kaya give her?
questions.note: "Her friend Kaya gives her a small cat."

questions.q: How does Zeynep feel in the evening?
questions.note: Akşam yorgun ama mutlu, yatmak istemiyor.

title: Doktorda
text: Murat does not feel well today. His head hurts and he is very hot. He calls his office and says, "I am ill. I cannot come to work." Then he goes to the doctor. The doctor asks many questions. She looks at his eyes and his mouth. She says, "You must stay at home for three days. Drink a lot of water and sleep." Murat buys medicine and goes home. His sister makes hot soup for him. After two days he feels better.
textTr: Murat bugün kendini iyi hissetmiyor. Başı ağrıyor ve ateşi çok yüksek. Ofisini arayıp "Hastayım, işe gelemiyorum" diyor. Sonra doktora gidiyor. Doktor birçok soru soruyor. Gözlerine ve ağzına bakıyor. "Üç gün evde kalmalısın. Bol su iç ve uyu" diyor. Murat ilaç alıp eve gidiyor. Kız kardeşi ona sıcak çorba yapıyor. İki gün sonra kendini daha iyi hissediyor.

questions.q: What is the problem with Murat?
questions.note: "His head hurts and he is very hot."

questions.q: What does the doctor say?
options: Stay at home for three days
questions.note: "You must stay at home for three days."

questions.q: Who makes soup for Murat?
questions.note: "His sister makes hot soup for him."

questions.q: How does Murat feel after two days?
questions.note: "After two days he feels better."

title: Odam
text: My room is not big but I like it. There is a bed near the window and a small table next to it. On the table there is a lamp, a clock and two books. My computer is on the desk. There are three pictures on the wall. My favorite picture is of the sea. Under the bed there is a box with old letters in it. The room is often cold in winter, so I close the window at night. I do my homework here every evening.
textTr: Odam büyük değil ama seviyorum. Pencerenin yanında bir yatak ve onun yanında küçük bir masa var. Masanın üstünde bir lamba, bir saat ve iki kitap var. Bilgisayarım çalışma masasının üstünde. Duvarda üç resim var. En sevdiğim resim denizin resmi. Yatağın altında içinde eski mektuplar olan bir kutu var. Oda kışın çoğu zaman soğuk oluyor, o yüzden geceleri pencereyi kapatıyorum. Her akşam ödevimi burada yapıyorum.

questions.q: Where is the bed?
questions.note: "There is a bed near the window."

questions.q: What is under the bed?
questions.note: "Under the bed there is a box with old letters."

questions.q: Why does the writer close the window at night?
questions.note: Oda kışın soğuk oluyor.

questions.q: What does the writer do in the room every evening?
questions.note: "I do my homework here every evening."

title: Yağmurlu gün
text: It is Saturday and it is raining. Berk wants to play football with his friends, but they cannot go to the park. He is not happy. His mother says, "Let's make pizza together." They go to the kitchen. Berk cuts the tomatoes and his mother makes the bread. The kitchen is warm and it smells good. After lunch they watch a film about animals. In the evening the rain stops. Berk looks out of the window and sees the moon. Tomorrow he can play football.
textTr: Cumartesi ve yağmur yağıyor. Berk arkadaşlarıyla futbol oynamak istiyor ama parka gidemiyorlar. Mutlu değil. Annesi "Hadi birlikte pizza yapalım" diyor. Mutfağa gidiyorlar. Berk domatesleri kesiyor, annesi hamuru yapıyor. Mutfak sıcak ve güzel kokuyor. Öğle yemeğinden sonra hayvanlarla ilgili bir film izliyorlar. Akşam yağmur duruyor. Berk pencereden dışarı bakıyor ve ayı görüyor. Yarın futbol oynayabilir.

questions.q: Why can't Berk play football?
questions.note: "It is Saturday and it is raining."

questions.q: What do Berk and his mother make?
questions.note: "Let's make pizza together."

questions.q: What do they watch after lunch?
questions.note: "They watch a film about animals."

questions.q: What happens in the evening?
questions.note: "In the evening the rain stops."

title: Yeni öğrenci
text: There is a new student in our class. Her name is Lina and she is from another country. She speaks three languages but her Turkish is not very good. On the first day she sits alone and says nothing. My friend Emre gives her a pen and asks her name. Now we eat lunch together every day. Lina teaches us words in her language and we help her with Turkish. She is funny and she draws very well. Our teacher says Lina is a good student.
textTr: Sınıfımızda yeni bir öğrenci var. Adı Lina ve başka bir ülkeden geliyor. Üç dil konuşuyor ama Türkçesi pek iyi değil. İlk gün tek başına oturuyor ve hiçbir şey söylemiyor. Arkadaşım Emre ona bir kalem veriyor ve adını soruyor. Artık her gün birlikte öğle yemeği yiyoruz. Lina bize kendi dilinde kelimeler öğretiyor, biz de ona Türkçede yardım ediyoruz. Komik biri ve çok güzel resim çiziyor. Öğretmenimiz Lina'nın iyi bir öğrenci olduğunu söylüyor.

questions.q: Where is Lina from?
questions.note: "She is from another country."

questions.q: What does Emre give her?
questions.note: "Emre gives her a pen and asks her name."

questions.q: What does Lina teach the class?
questions.note: "Lina teaches us words in her language."

questions.q: What is Lina good at?
questions.note: "She draws very well."

title: En yakın arkadaşım
text: My best friend is Elif. We are in the same class. She is seventeen years old and she lives near my house. Elif is tall and she has long black hair. She is very funny. We walk to school together every morning. After school we do our homework at her house. Her mother makes good cakes. On Saturdays we go to the park or we watch a film. Elif wants to be a doctor. She reads many books about the body. I am not good at science but she helps me. She is a very good friend.
textTr: En yakın arkadaşım Elif. Aynı sınıftayız. On yedi yaşında ve evimin yakınında oturuyor. Elif uzun boylu ve uzun siyah saçları var. Çok komik biri. Her sabah birlikte okula yürüyoruz. Okuldan sonra ödevlerimizi onun evinde yapıyoruz. Annesi güzel kekler yapıyor. Cumartesileri parka gidiyoruz ya da film izliyoruz. Elif doktor olmak istiyor. Vücut hakkında çok kitap okuyor. Ben fende iyi değilim ama o bana yardım ediyor. Çok iyi bir arkadaş.

questions.q: How old is Elif?
questions.note: "She is seventeen years old."

questions.q: Where do they do their homework?
questions.note: "We do our homework at her house."

questions.q: What does Elif want to be?
questions.note: "Elif wants to be a doctor."

questions.q: Who makes good cakes?
questions.note: "Her mother makes good cakes."

questions.q: What do they do on Saturdays?
options: Go to the park or watch a film
questions.note: "On Saturdays we go to the park or we watch a film."

title: Evde kahvaltı
text: In my family we always eat breakfast together. It is my favorite time of the day. My mother makes tea. My father buys bread from the shop on the corner. We eat cheese, olives, eggs and tomatoes. My little brother Kerem does not like tomatoes. He only eats bread and honey. On school days breakfast is short because we are in a hurry. But on Sundays we sit at the table for one hour. We talk about the week. My grandmother comes and she brings fruit from her garden.
textTr: Ailemizde kahvaltıyı hep birlikte ederiz. Günün en sevdiğim vakti. Annem çay yapar. Babam köşedeki dükkândan ekmek alır. Peynir, zeytin, yumurta ve domates yeriz. Küçük kardeşim Kerem domates sevmez. Sadece ekmek ve bal yer. Okul günlerinde kahvaltı kısa sürer çünkü acelemiz olur. Ama pazar günleri bir saat masada otururuz. Haftayı konuşuruz. Büyükannem gelir ve bahçesinden meyve getirir.

questions.q: Who makes the tea?
questions.note: "My mother makes tea."

questions.q: What does Kerem not like?
questions.note: "My little brother Kerem does not like tomatoes."

questions.q: Why is breakfast short on school days?
options: It is not a school day
questions.note: "Breakfast is short because we are in a hurry."

questions.q: How long is breakfast on Sundays?
questions.note: "On Sundays we sit at the table for one hour."

questions.q: What does the grandmother bring?
questions.note: "She brings fruit from her garden."

title: Okula giden otobüs
text: I take the bus to school every day. The bus stop is in front of the bank. I wait there at half past seven. The bus is number twelve. In the morning it is always full. Sometimes I stand for twenty minutes. The driver is an old man. His name is Mehmet and he says good morning to every student. I like him. I sit near the window and I look at the street. I see the same shops and the same people every day. The bus is not fast but it is cheap.
textTr: Her gün okula otobüsle giderim. Otobüs durağı bankanın önünde. Yedi buçukta orada beklerim. Otobüsün numarası on iki. Sabahları hep doludur. Bazen yirmi dakika ayakta dururum. Şoför yaşlı bir adam. Adı Mehmet ve her öğrenciye günaydın der. Onu severim. Pencerenin yanına otururum ve sokağa bakarım. Her gün aynı dükkânları ve aynı insanları görürüm. Otobüs hızlı değil ama ucuz.

questions.q: Where is the bus stop?
questions.note: "The bus stop is in front of the bank."

questions.q: What time does the writer wait?
questions.note: "I wait there at half past seven."

questions.q: Why does the writer sometimes stand?
options: There are no seats on the bus
questions.note: "In the morning it is always full."

questions.q: What does the driver do every morning?
questions.note: "He says good morning to every student."

questions.q: What does the writer say about the bus?
questions.note: "The bus is not fast but it is cheap."

title: Kedim
text: I have a cat. Her name is Duman. She is three years old and she is gray and white. We found her in the street two years ago. She was very small and very thin. Now she is big and she eats a lot. Duman sleeps all day on my bed. At night she is not tired and she runs in the house. She likes fish and she does not like water. When I come home from school she waits at the door. She is not a quiet cat. She talks to me and she wants food. I love her very much.
textTr: Bir kedim var. Adı Duman. Üç yaşında, gri ve beyaz. Onu iki yıl önce sokakta bulduk. Çok küçüktü ve çok zayıftı. Şimdi büyük ve çok yiyor. Duman bütün gün yatağımda uyuyor. Geceleri yorgun olmuyor ve evde koşuyor. Balığı seviyor, suyu sevmiyor. Okuldan eve geldiğimde kapıda bekliyor. Sessiz bir kedi değil. Benimle konuşuyor ve yemek istiyor. Onu çok seviyorum.

questions.q: How old is the cat?
questions.note: "She is three years old."

questions.q: Where did they find her?
questions.note: "We found her in the street two years ago."

questions.q: What does the cat do all day?
questions.note: "Duman sleeps all day on my bed."

questions.q: What does the cat not like?
questions.note: "She does not like water."

questions.q: Where does the cat wait after school?
questions.note: "She waits at the door."

title: Parkta bir gün
text: There is a big park near my house. On Sunday morning I go there with my sister Ayse. Many people are in the park. Old men play games at the tables. Children run and play football. Some people walk with their dogs. We sit on a bench under a tree and we eat our sandwiches. There is a small lake and we look at the birds. In summer the park is very green. In winter it is cold and there are not many people. But I like the park in every season.
textTr: Evimin yakınında büyük bir park var. Pazar sabahı oraya kız kardeşim Ayşe ile giderim. Parkta çok insan olur. Yaşlı adamlar masalarda oyun oynar. Çocuklar koşar ve futbol oynar. Bazı insanlar köpekleriyle yürür. Bir ağacın altındaki banka otururuz ve sandviçlerimizi yeriz. Küçük bir göl var ve kuşlara bakarız. Yazın park çok yeşil olur. Kışın soğuk olur ve çok insan olmaz. Ama parkı her mevsim severim.

questions.q: When does the writer go to the park?
questions.note: "On Sunday morning I go there with my sister."

questions.q: What do the old men do?
options: They play games at the tables
questions.note: "Old men play games at the tables."

questions.q: Where do the sisters sit?
options: On a bench under a tree
questions.note: "We sit on a bench under a tree."

questions.q: What is the park like in winter?
questions.note: "In winter it is cold and there are not many people."

questions.q: How does the writer feel about the park?
options: She likes it only in summer
She likes it in every season
She goes there in winter only
questions.note: Son cümle.

title: Büyükannem
text: My grandmother lives in a small house with a big garden. She is seventy-two years old. Every summer I stay with her for two weeks. In the morning we work in the garden. She has tomatoes, beans and flowers. She knows the name of every plant. In the afternoon it is hot and we sit inside. She tells me stories about her village. Her mother and father were farmers. She did not go to school after twelve. But she reads the newspaper every day and she is very clever.
textTr: Büyükannem büyük bahçeli küçük bir evde yaşıyor. Yetmiş iki yaşında. Her yaz iki hafta onda kalırım. Sabahları bahçede çalışırız. Domatesi, fasulyesi ve çiçekleri var. Her bitkinin adını bilir. Öğleden sonra hava sıcak olur ve içeride otururuz. Bana köyüyle ilgili hikâyeler anlatır. Annesi ve babası çiftçiymiş. On ikiden sonra okula gitmemiş. Ama her gün gazete okur ve çok zekidir.

questions.q: How old is the grandmother?
questions.note: "She is seventy-two years old."

questions.q: How long does the writer stay?
questions.note: "I stay with her for two weeks."

questions.q: What do they do in the morning?
questions.note: "In the morning we work in the garden."

questions.q: What were her parents?
questions.note: "Her mother and father were farmers."

questions.q: What does she do every day?
questions.note: "She reads the newspaper every day."

title: Futbol maçı
text: On Saturday my father and I went to a football match. The stadium was near the sea. It was very big and there were thousands of people. Our seats were high but we could see everything. The match started at four o'clock. The first half was not good. Nobody made a goal. After the break our team played better. Emre made a goal in the last ten minutes. Everybody stood up and shouted. My father was very happy. We came home late and we talked about the match all evening.
textTr: Cumartesi babamla bir futbol maçına gittik. Stadyum denizin yakınındaydı. Çok büyüktü ve binlerce insan vardı. Yerlerimiz yüksekti ama her şeyi görebiliyorduk. Maç saat dörtte başladı. İlk yarı iyi değildi. Kimse gol atamadı. Aradan sonra takımımız daha iyi oynadı. Emre son on dakikada gol attı. Herkes ayağa kalktı ve bağırdı. Babam çok mutluydu. Eve geç geldik ve bütün akşam maçı konuştuk.

questions.q: Where was the stadium?
questions.note: "The stadium was near the sea."

questions.q: What time did the match start?
questions.note: "The match started at four o'clock."

questions.q: What happened in the first half?
questions.note: "Nobody made a goal."

questions.q: When did Emre make the goal?
questions.note: "Emre made a goal in the last ten minutes."

questions.q: What did they do at home?
questions.note: "We talked about the match all evening."

title: Mutfakta
text: Our kitchen is small but it is my favorite room. There is a window over the sink and I can see the street. My mother cooks there every day. On Fridays she makes soup and rice. I help her. I wash the vegetables and I put the plates on the table. My sister Zeynep does not help. She says she is busy with her homework, but she is on her phone. After dinner we all clean the kitchen together. My father washes the plates and he sings. He is not a good singer.
textTr: Mutfağımız küçük ama en sevdiğim oda. Lavabonun üstünde bir pencere var ve sokağı görebiliyorum. Annem orada her gün yemek yapar. Cumaları çorba ve pilav yapar. Ona yardım ederim. Sebzeleri yıkarım ve tabakları masaya koyarım. Kız kardeşim Zeynep yardım etmez. Ödevle meşgul olduğunu söyler ama telefondadır. Yemekten sonra hep birlikte mutfağı temizleriz. Babam tabakları yıkar ve şarkı söyler. İyi bir şarkıcı değildir.

questions.q: What can the writer see from the window?
questions.note: "I can see the street."

questions.q: What does the mother make on Fridays?
questions.note: "On Fridays she makes soup and rice."

questions.q: What does the writer do to help?
questions.note: "I wash the vegetables and I put the plates on the table."

questions.q: What is Zeynep really doing?
questions.note: "She says she is busy with her homework, but she is on her phone."

questions.q: What does the father do after dinner?
questions.note: "My father washes the plates and he sings."

title: En sevdiğim mevsim
text: My favorite season is autumn. In summer it is too hot in my city and I cannot sleep. In winter it is cold and dark at five o'clock. But in autumn the weather is good. It is not hot and it is not cold. The trees are yellow and red. I can walk for hours. School starts again and I see my friends. My mother makes soup in the evening. I like the rain too. I sit near the window with a book and I listen to it. Autumn is short but it is beautiful.
textTr: En sevdiğim mevsim sonbahar. Yazın şehrimde hava çok sıcak oluyor ve uyuyamıyorum. Kışın soğuk oluyor ve saat beşte karanlık oluyor. Ama sonbaharda hava güzel. Ne sıcak ne soğuk. Ağaçlar sarı ve kırmızı oluyor. Saatlerce yürüyebiliyorum. Okul tekrar başlıyor ve arkadaşlarımı görüyorum. Annem akşamları çorba yapıyor. Yağmuru da seviyorum. Pencerenin yanına kitapla oturup onu dinliyorum. Sonbahar kısa ama güzel.

questions.q: Which season does the writer like best?
questions.note: "My favorite season is autumn."

questions.q: What is the problem with summer?
options: It is too hot to sleep
questions.note: "In summer it is too hot in my city and I cannot sleep."

questions.q: What color are the trees in autumn?
questions.note: "The trees are yellow and red."

questions.q: What does the writer do when it rains?
options: Sits near the window with a book
questions.note: "I sit near the window with a book."

questions.q: What does the writer say about autumn?
questions.note: Son cümle.

title: Okul kütüphanesi
text: Our school library is on the second floor. It is open from nine to five. There are many books and six computers. Students can take two books for two weeks. Mrs Yilmaz works there. She is quiet and she knows every book in the room. When I want a book about animals, she finds it in one minute. In the library we cannot eat or talk. Some students only come for the computers. I come for the big table near the window. It is the best place in the school for homework.
textTr: Okul kütüphanemiz ikinci katta. Dokuzdan beşe kadar açık. Çok kitap ve altı bilgisayar var. Öğrenciler iki haftalığına iki kitap alabilir. Orada Yılmaz Hanım çalışıyor. Sessiz biri ve odadaki her kitabı biliyor. Hayvanlarla ilgili bir kitap istediğimde bir dakikada buluyor. Kütüphanede yemek yiyemeyiz ve konuşamayız. Bazı öğrenciler sadece bilgisayarlar için geliyor. Ben pencerenin yanındaki büyük masa için geliyorum. Ödev için okuldaki en iyi yer.

questions.q: Where is the library?
questions.note: "Our school library is on the second floor."

questions.q: How many books can a student take?
questions.note: "Students can take two books for two weeks."

questions.q: What is Mrs Yilmaz good at?
questions.note: "She finds it in one minute."

questions.q: What can students not do in the library?
questions.note: "In the library we cannot eat or talk."

questions.q: Why does the writer go there?
options: For the big table near the window
questions.note: "I come for the big table near the window."

title: Komşumuz
text: Our neighbor is Hasan. He lives alone in the flat under us. He is sixty years old. Every morning he goes out at eight with his newspaper and he sits in the small cafe on our street. He comes home at eleven. In the afternoon he works in front of the building. He waters the flowers and he cleans the door. Nobody asks him to do it. When my mother makes too much food, she gives some to him. He always says thank you and he brings us bread the next day.
textTr: Komşumuz Hasan. Altımızdaki dairede yalnız yaşıyor. Altmış yaşında. Her sabah sekizde gazetesiyle çıkıyor ve sokağımızdaki küçük kafede oturuyor. On birde eve dönüyor. Öğleden sonra binanın önünde çalışıyor. Çiçekleri suluyor ve kapıyı temizliyor. Kimse ondan bunu istemiyor. Annem fazla yemek yaptığında ona da veriyor. Hep teşekkür ediyor ve ertesi gün bize ekmek getiriyor.

questions.q: Where does Hasan live?
questions.note: "He lives alone in the flat under us."

questions.q: What does he take to the cafe?
questions.note: "He goes out at eight with his newspaper."

questions.q: What does he do in the afternoon?
options: Works in front of the building
questions.note: "In the afternoon he works in front of the building."

questions.q: Who asks him to clean the door?
questions.note: "Nobody asks him to do it."

questions.q: What does he give the family?
questions.note: "He brings us bread the next day."

title: Kışlık ceket
text: Last week I went shopping with my mother. I needed a winter coat. My old coat was too small. We went to three shops. In the first shop the coats were beautiful but too expensive. In the second shop there was nothing in my size. In the third shop I found a black coat. It was warm and it was not expensive. My mother said the color was boring. I said black is good with everything. We bought it. Now I wear it every day and my mother says it was a good choice.
textTr: Geçen hafta annemle alışverişe gittim. Kışlık bir cekete ihtiyacım vardı. Eski ceketim çok küçüktü. Üç dükkâna gittik. İlk dükkânda ceketler güzeldi ama çok pahalıydı. İkinci dükkânda benim bedenimde hiçbir şey yoktu. Üçüncü dükkânda siyah bir ceket buldum. Sıcaktı ve pahalı değildi. Annem rengin sıkıcı olduğunu söyledi. Ben siyahın her şeyle iyi gittiğini söyledim. Onu aldık. Şimdi her gün giyiyorum ve annem iyi bir seçim olduğunu söylüyor.

questions.q: Why did the writer need a coat?
options: The old one was too small
questions.note: "My old coat was too small."

questions.q: What was wrong with the first shop?
options: There was nothing in her size
questions.note: "The coats were beautiful but too expensive."

questions.q: What was the problem in the second shop?
questions.note: "There was nothing in my size."

questions.q: What did the mother say about the coat?
questions.note: "My mother said the color was boring."

questions.q: What does the mother say now?
questions.note: Son cümle.

title: Müzik dersi
text: I have a music lesson on Tuesdays after school. My teacher is Selin. She teaches me the guitar. My first lesson was very difficult. My fingers hurt and I could not play one song. Selin said this is not a problem. Now I can play four songs. I practice for twenty minutes every evening. My brother closes his door because he says it is loud. In June there is a small concert at the music school. All the students play one song. I am not ready but Selin says I will be ready.
textTr: Salı günleri okuldan sonra müzik dersim var. Öğretmenim Selin. Bana gitar öğretiyor. İlk dersim çok zordu. Parmaklarım acıdı ve bir şarkı bile çalamadım. Selin bunun sorun olmadığını söyledi. Şimdi dört şarkı çalabiliyorum. Her akşam yirmi dakika çalışıyorum. Kardeşim kapısını kapatıyor çünkü sesin yüksek olduğunu söylüyor. Haziranda müzik okulunda küçük bir konser var. Bütün öğrenciler bir şarkı çalıyor. Hazır değilim ama Selin hazır olacağımı söylüyor.

questions.q: When is the music lesson?
questions.note: "I have a music lesson on Tuesdays after school."

questions.q: What was difficult in the first lesson?
questions.note: "My fingers hurt and I could not play one song."

questions.q: How many songs can she play now?
questions.note: "Now I can play four songs."

questions.q: Why does her brother close his door?
options: He does not like the song
questions.note: "He says it is loud."

questions.q: What happens in June?
questions.note: "In June there is a small concert at the music school."

title: Yeni telefon
text: For my birthday my parents gave me a phone. It is my first phone. I was very happy. The first day I looked at it for five hours. My father was not happy about that. Now we have a rule in our house. No phones at dinner. No phones after ten o'clock at night. At first the rule was difficult for me. My friend Baran writes to me in the evening and I cannot answer. But now I sleep better and I read more. The rule is good but I do not say that to my father.
textTr: Doğum günümde ailem bana bir telefon verdi. İlk telefonum. Çok mutlu oldum. İlk gün beş saat ona baktım. Babam bundan memnun olmadı. Şimdi evimizde bir kural var. Yemekte telefon yok. Gece ondan sonra telefon yok. Başta kural bana zor geldi. Arkadaşım Baran akşamları yazıyor ve cevap veremiyorum. Ama şimdi daha iyi uyuyorum ve daha çok okuyorum. Kural iyi ama bunu babama söylemiyorum.

questions.q: Who gave the phone?
questions.note: "My parents gave me a phone."

questions.q: What did he do on the first day?
options: Looked at it for five hours
questions.note: "The first day I looked at it for five hours."

questions.q: What is the rule at dinner?
questions.note: "No phones at dinner."

questions.q: What is better now?
options: He sleeps better and reads more
questions.note: "Now I sleep better and I read more."

questions.q: What does he not tell his father?
options: That he wants a new phone
questions.note: Son cümle.

title: Denizde bir gün
text: Last August we went to Antalya for one week. The hotel was old but the sea was in front of it. Every morning I got up at seven and I ran on the sand. The water was warm. My mother does not swim so she read her book under a tree. My father made friends with a man from another hotel and they played cards for hours. In the evening we ate fish in a small restaurant. On the last day I did not want to go home. But school started in two weeks.
textTr: Geçen ağustos bir haftalığına Antalya'ya gittik. Otel eskiydi ama deniz önündeydi. Her sabah yedide kalkıp kumda koştum. Su sıcaktı. Annem yüzmez, o yüzden bir ağacın altında kitabını okudu. Babam başka bir otelden bir adamla arkadaş oldu ve saatlerce kâğıt oynadılar. Akşamları küçük bir lokantada balık yedik. Son gün eve gitmek istemedim. Ama okul iki hafta sonra başlıyordu.

questions.q: How long was the holiday?
questions.note: "We went to Antalya for one week."

questions.q: What did the writer do every morning?
questions.note: "I got up at seven and I ran on the sand."

questions.q: What did the mother do?
options: Read her book under a tree
questions.note: "She read her book under a tree."

questions.q: What did the father do?
options: Played cards with a new friend
questions.note: "They played cards for hours."

questions.q: How did the writer feel on the last day?
options: He was happy to go home
He did not want to go home
questions.note: "On the last day I did not want to go home."
